batch_onboard_receipt.label: Batch onboard receipt
batch_onboard_receipt.requires: Nothing. Per-ticker onboard checklists carry the reviewable content.
batch_onboard_receipt.rationale: Run receipt for a batch whose per-ticker artifacts are queued separately.

sleeve_onboard_proposal.label: Sleeve onboard proposal
sleeve_onboard_proposal.requires: Approve or reject the proposed sleeve additions, then move to approved/.

dispatch_receipt.label: Agent dispatch receipt
dispatch_receipt.requires: Nothing. The dispatched work reports through its own artifact.
dispatch_receipt.rationale: Records that jobs were dispatched; carries no verdict.

world_model_review.label: World-model review
world_model_review.requires: Confirm or reject the proposed world-model / KPI context change.

cross_check.label: Cross-check report
cross_check.requires: Adjudicate the disagreements between sources before the valuation is trusted.

deep_dive.label: Deep dive
deep_dive.requires: Read the dive, set stance/archetype, then move to approved/. Never auto-expires.

onboard_checklist.label: Onboard checklist
onboard_checklist.requires: Only the items the auto-close pass could not clear (see blockers below).

portfolio_news.label: Portfolio news scan
portfolio_news.requires: Skim refresh-eligible rows; anything actioned becomes an event or a dive.
portfolio_news.rationale: Digest of a rolling 30-day feed window; at 30 days a newer digest covers the same window.

darwin_regime_brief.label: Darwin regime brief
darwin_regime_brief.requires: Nothing once a newer brief exists; the brief states the regime as of its date.
darwin_regime_brief.rationale: States the CURRENT regime. A stale regime label is not reviewable, it is wrong.

transcript_coverage.label: Transcript coverage report
transcript_coverage.requires: Nothing; it is a coverage metric, not a verdict queue.
transcript_coverage.rationale: Restates coverage for all holdings every run; the newest file dominates.

ls_algo_ic_queue.label: ls-algo IC queue
ls_algo_ic_queue.requires: Act on the newest queue only; triggers are price-dependent and go stale daily.
ls_algo_ic_queue.rationale: Snapshot of live triggers at that day's prices; a stale trigger list is misleading.

fund_family_proposals.label: Fund family proposals
fund_family_proposals.rationale: Re-detected from scratch each run; unpromoted proposals reappear in the newer file.

event_triage.label: Event triage table
event_triage.requires: Adjudicate borderline events in the NEWEST table only.
event_triage.rationale: Full daily restatement of every unresolved row; still-open rows carry forward.

filing_insights.label: Filing insights table
filing_insights.requires: Adjudicate low-confidence parser rows in the NEWEST table only.
filing_insights.rationale: Full daily restatement of unresolved parser rows.

activist_triage.label: Activist triage table
activist_triage.requires: Adjudicate unresolved activist rows in the NEWEST table only.
activist_triage.rationale: Cumulative: row count only grows, so the newest table strictly contains the older ones.

activist_press_digest.label: Activist press digest
activist_press_digest.requires: Read letters that matter for a held name; rows persist in the newer digest.
activist_press_digest.rationale: Restated from a fixed seed list each run; nothing is unique to an old copy.

memory_digest.label: Weekly memory digest
memory_digest.requires: Promote approved bullets into MEMORY.md, log rejections in corrections.md.
memory_digest.rationale: Non-overlapping weekly windows: an unreviewed week is NOT restated later.

cvr_discovery.label: CVR discovery
cvr_discovery.requires: Confirm newly discovered CVRs before they enter the universe.

depth_scorecard.label: Deep dive depth scorecard
depth_scorecard.requires: Decide which thin dives get re-run.

plan_proposal.label: Plan / proposal
plan_proposal.requires: Accept, amend or reject the proposed change of process.

one_off_note.label: One-off analysis / audit
one_off_note.requires: Read once and file; these were written for a specific question.

standing_doc.label: Standing working document
standing_doc.requires: No date, no cadence: the human moves it out when it stops being useful.

onboard_blocker_groups.fix: The named fields are still at the onboarding defaults (archetype='unknown', moat='unproven', dhando='pending', stance='watch', cycle='-', moi_bucket='pending', payoff_lens='pending'). The checklist asks a human to confirm them, so a default cannot count as confirmed.
Add at least one investor-relations root URL to holdings.<T>.download.ir_roots. An empty list is not a verified IR URL.

The checklist's 'review deep dive PR when Cloud Agent completes' line is only waivable once the dive exists. Run the deep dive (or drop the ticker) so that a {TICKER}/research/deep_dive_{date}.md or a {TICKER}_deep_dive_{date}.md review artifact is on disk.
Assign holdings.<T>.classification.investment_sleeve; '-' is the no-sleeve sentinel, not a sleeve.
holdings.<T>.company is still the bare symbol; set the real legal name.
Set holdings.<T>.download.cik from SEC EDGAR, and add the same CIK to _system/scripts/us_ticker_config.json (it is read first and shadows the registry).
